representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
input_path <- args[[1]]
output_path <- args[[2]]

xml_unescape <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub('<', '<', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('>', '>', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('"', '"', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(''', "'", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('&', '&', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}

get_attr <- function(x, attr) {
  pat <- paste0(attr, '="([^"]*)"')
  m <- regexpr(pat, x, perl = TRUE)
  if (m[1] < 0) return(NA_character_)
  hit <- regmatches(x, m)
  sub(pat, '\\1', hit, perl = TRUE)
}

col_index <- function(ref) {
  letters <- gsub('[^A-Z]', '', ref)
  vals <- utf8ToInt(letters) - utf8ToInt('A') + 1L
  sum(vals * 26L ^ rev(seq_along(vals) - 1L))
}

read_file_one <- function(path) paste(readLines(path, warn = FALSE), collapse = '')

read_shared_strings <- function(root) {
  p <- file.path(root, 'xl', 'sharedStrings.xml')
  if (!file.exists(p)) return(character())
  xml <- read_file_one(p)
  sis <- regmatches(xml, gregexpr('<si[^>]*>.*?</si>', xml, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
  vapply(sis, function(si) {
    ts <- regmatches(si, gregexpr('<t[^>]*>.*?</t>', si, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
    if (length(ts) == 0L || identical(ts, character(0))) return('')
    txt <- gsub('^<t[^>]*>|</t>$', '', ts, perl = TRUE)
    xml_unescape(paste(txt, collapse = ''))
  }, character(1))
}

cell_value <- function(cell, shared) {
  typ <- get_attr(cell, 't')
  if (!is.na(typ) && typ == 'inlineStr') {
    ts <- regmatches(cell, gregexpr('<t[^>]*>.*?</t>', cell, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
    if (length(ts) == 0L || identical(ts, character(0))) return(NA_character_)
    txt <- gsub('^<t[^>]*>|</t>$', '', ts, perl = TRUE)
    return(xml_unescape(paste(txt, collapse = '')))
  }
  m <- regexpr('<v[^>]*>.*?</v>', cell, perl = TRUE)
  if (m[1] < 0) return(NA_character_)
  raw <- regmatches(cell, m)
  val <- gsub('^<v[^>]*>|</v>$', '', raw, perl = TRUE)
  val <- xml_unescape(val)
  if (!is.na(typ) && typ == 's') return(shared[as.integer(val) + 1L])
  val
}

read_xlsx_first_sheet <- function(path) {
  root <- tempfile('xlsx_')
  dir.create(root)
  utils::unzip(path, exdir = root)
  sheet_paths <- sort(list.files(file.path(root, 'xl', 'worksheets'), pattern = '^sheet[0-9]+[.]xml$', full.names = TRUE))
  if (length(sheet_paths) < 1L) stop('No worksheet XML found')
  shared <- read_shared_strings(root)
  xml <- read_file_one(sheet_paths[1])
  row_xml <- regmatches(xml, gregexpr('<row[^>]*>.*?</row>', xml, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
  rows <- list()
  max_col <- 0L
  for (row in row_xml) {
    row_tag <- regmatches(row, regexpr('^<row[^>]*>', row, perl = TRUE))
    r <- as.integer(get_attr(row_tag, 'r'))
    if (is.na(r)) next
    cells <- regmatches(row, gregexpr('<c[^>]*/>|<c[^>]*>.*?</c>', row, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
    if (length(cells) == 0L || identical(cells, character(0))) next
    vals <- list()
    for (cell in cells) {
      ref <- get_attr(cell, 'r')
      if (is.na(ref)) next
      ci <- col_index(ref)
      vals[[as.character(ci)]] <- cell_value(cell, shared)
      if (ci > max_col) max_col <- ci
    }
    rows[[as.character(r)]] <- vals
  }
  if (length(rows) < 1L) stop('No worksheet rows parsed')
  max_row <- max(as.integer(names(rows)))
  mat <- matrix(NA_character_, nrow = max_row, ncol = max_col)
  for (rn in names(rows)) {
    for (cn in names(rows[[rn]])) mat[as.integer(rn), as.integer(cn)] <- rows[[rn]][[cn]]
  }
  headers <- mat[1, ]
  keep <- which(!is.na(headers) & nzchar(trimws(headers)))
  df <- as.data.frame(mat[-1, keep, drop = FALSE], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(df) <- make.names(headers[keep], unique = TRUE)
  attr(df, 'raw_headers') <- headers[keep]
  df
}

df <- read_xlsx_first_sheet(input_path)
raw_headers <- attr(df, 'raw_headers')
eff_col <- which(raw_headers == 'Efficacy')
bmi_col <- which(raw_headers == 'BMI')
if (length(eff_col) != 1L || length(bmi_col) != 1L) stop('Required Efficacy and BMI columns not found exactly once')

efficacy <- trimws(df[[eff_col]])
bmi <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[bmi_col]]))
y <- ifelse(!is.na(efficacy) & toupper(efficacy) == 'PR', 1, ifelse(is.na(efficacy) | efficacy == '', NA, 0))
analysis_df <- data.frame(PR = y, BMI = bmi)
analysis_df <- analysis_df[complete.cases(analysis_df), , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(analysis_df) == 0L) stop('No complete rows for model')
if (length(unique(analysis_df$PR)) != 2L) stop('Outcome does not contain both PR and non-PR classes')
fit <- glm(PR ~ BMI, family = binomial(), data = analysis_df)
result <- data.frame(
  metric = c('aic', 'n_complete', 'event_PR', 'non_event', 'coefficients', 'formula'),
  value = c(format(AIC(fit), digits = 17, scientific = FALSE),
            as.character(nrow(analysis_df)),
            as.character(sum(analysis_df$PR == 1)),
            as.character(sum(analysis_df$PR == 0)),
            paste(names(coef(fit)), format(coef(fit), digits = 17, scientific = FALSE), sep = '=', collapse = ';'),
            'glm(PR ~ BMI, family=binomial)')
)
write.table(result, file = output_path, sep = '\t', row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
RSCRIPT
Rscript analysis.R "$(inputs.input.path)" aic_result.tsv

xml_unescape <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub('<', '<', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('>', '>', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('"', '"', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(''', "'", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('&', '&', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}

get_attr <- function(x, attr) {
  pat <- paste0(attr, '="([^"]*)"')
  m <- regexpr(pat, x, perl = TRUE)
  if (m[1] < 0) return(NA_character_)
  hit <- regmatches(x, m)
  sub(pat, '\1', hit, perl = TRUE)
}

col_index <- function(ref) {
  letters <- gsub('[^A-Z]', '', ref)
  vals <- utf8ToInt(letters) - utf8ToInt('A') + 1L
  sum(vals * 26L ^ rev(seq_along(vals) - 1L))
}

read_file_one <- function(path) paste(readLines(path, warn = FALSE), collapse = '')

read_shared_strings <- function(root) {
  p <- file.path(root, 'xl', 'sharedStrings.xml')
  if (!file.exists(p)) return(character())
  xml <- read_file_one(p)
  sis <- regmatches(xml, gregexpr('<si[^>]*>.*?</si>', xml, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
  vapply(sis, function(si) {
    ts <- regmatches(si, gregexpr('<t[^>]*>.*?</t>', si, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
    if (length(ts) == 0L || identical(ts, character(0))) return('')
    txt <- gsub('^<t[^>]*>|</t>$', '', ts, perl = TRUE)
    xml_unescape(paste(txt, collapse = ''))
  }, character(1))
}

cell_value <- function(cell, shared) {
  typ <- get_attr(cell, 't')
  if (!is.na(typ) && typ == 'inlineStr') {
    ts <- regmatches(cell, gregexpr('<t[^>]*>.*?</t>', cell, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
    if (length(ts) == 0L || identical(ts, character(0))) return(NA_character_)
    txt <- gsub('^<t[^>]*>|</t>$', '', ts, perl = TRUE)
    return(xml_unescape(paste(txt, collapse = '')))
  }
  m <- regexpr('<v[^>]*>.*?</v>', cell, perl = TRUE)
  if (m[1] < 0) return(NA_character_)
  raw <- regmatches(cell, m)
  val <- gsub('^<v[^>]*>|</v>$', '', raw, perl = TRUE)
  val <- xml_unescape(val)
  if (!is.na(typ) && typ == 's') return(shared[as.integer(val) + 1L])
  val
}

read_xlsx_first_sheet <- function(path) {
  root <- tempfile('xlsx_')
  dir.create(root)
  utils::unzip(path, exdir = root)
  sheet_paths <- sort(list.files(file.path(root, 'xl', 'worksheets'), pattern = '^sheet[0-9]+[.]xml$', full.names = TRUE))
  if (length(sheet_paths) < 1L) stop('No worksheet XML found')
  shared <- read_shared_strings(root)
  xml <- read_file_one(sheet_paths[1])
  row_xml <- regmatches(xml, gregexpr('<row[^>]*>.*?</row>', xml, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
  rows <- list()
  max_col <- 0L
  for (row in row_xml) {
    row_tag <- regmatches(row, regexpr('^<row[^>]*>', row, perl = TRUE))
    r <- as.integer(get_attr(row_tag, 'r'))
    if (is.na(r)) next
    cells <- regmatches(row, gregexpr('<c[^>]*/>|<c[^>]*>.*?</c>', row, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
    if (length(cells) == 0L || identical(cells, character(0))) next
    vals <- list()
    for (cell in cells) {
      ref <- get_attr(cell, 'r')
      if (is.na(ref)) next
      ci <- col_index(ref)
      vals[[as.character(ci)]] <- cell_value(cell, shared)
      if (ci > max_col) max_col <- ci
    }
    rows[[as.character(r)]] <- vals
  }
  if (length(rows) < 1L) stop('No worksheet rows parsed')
  max_row <- max(as.integer(names(rows)))
  mat <- matrix(NA_character_, nrow = max_row, ncol = max_col)
  for (rn in names(rows)) {
    for (cn in names(rows[[rn]])) mat[as.integer(rn), as.integer(cn)] <- rows[[rn]][[cn]]
  }
  headers <- mat[1, ]
  keep <- which(!is.na(headers) & nzchar(trimws(headers)))
  df <- as.data.frame(mat[-1, keep, drop = FALSE], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(df) <- make.names(headers[keep], unique = TRUE)
  attr(df, 'raw_headers') <- headers[keep]
  df
}

df <- read_xlsx_first_sheet(input_path)
raw_headers <- attr(df, 'raw_headers')
eff_col <- which(raw_headers == 'Efficacy')
bmi_col <- which(raw_headers == 'BMI')
if (length(eff_col) != 1L || length(bmi_col) != 1L) stop('Required Efficacy and BMI columns not found exactly once')

efficacy <- trimws(df[[eff_col]])
bmi <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[bmi_col]]))
y <- ifelse(!is.na(efficacy) & toupper(efficacy) == 'PR', 1, ifelse(is.na(efficacy) | efficacy == '', NA, 0))
analysis_df <- data.frame(PR = y, BMI = bmi)
analysis_df <- analysis_df[complete.cases(analysis_df), , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(analysis_df) == 0L) stop('No complete rows for model')
if (length(unique(analysis_df$PR)) != 2L) stop('Outcome does not contain both PR and non-PR classes')
fit <- glm(PR ~ BMI, family = binomial(), data = analysis_df)
result <- data.frame(
  metric = c('aic', 'n_complete', 'event_PR', 'non_event', 'coefficients', 'formula'),
  value = c(format(AIC(fit), digits = 17, scientific = FALSE),
            as.character(nrow(analysis_df)),
            as.character(sum(analysis_df$PR == 1)),
            as.character(sum(analysis_df$PR == 0)),
            paste(names(coef(fit)), format(coef(fit), digits = 17, scientific = FALSE), sep = '=', collapse = ';'),
            'glm(PR ~ BMI, family=binomial)')
)
write.table(result, file = output_path, sep = '\t', row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
